subject: Sales → CS: AstraNova kickoff readiness & acceptance checklist
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Cole <jordan.cole@astranova.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sales → CS: AstraNova kickoff readiness & acceptance checklist

Hi team,

AstraNova verbally committed to a June 14 go-live in today's wrap with their CTO (Jordan) and procurement (Samantha). Quick summary and asks so CS can start planning:

- Account: AstraNova Therapeutics (focused on clinical insights)
- Expected seats: 10 developer seats, 2 enterprise admin seats
- Target go-live: 2027-06-14 (allowed ±1 week)
- Key constraints: data residency in us-east-1, must pass security checklist (SOC2 + encryption at rest + customer KMS)
- Open items: final SOW (attached draft), signed MSA, procurement PO (Samantha), IP/usage limits

Attachments: SOW_Draft_v1.pdf (draft, redlines expected), MAP_AstraNova_GoLive.xlsx
Shared MAP: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AstraNova-MAP
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

Immediate asks for CS:
1) Assign lead and secondary for onboarding and implementation. Prefer owners by EOD tomorrow.
2) Review SOW draft and flag any items that will impact timeline or PM staffing.
3) Security intake: confirm required evidence and ETA for completion.

Jordan/Samantha — feel free to add anything I missed. We'll loop in Legal once we have procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: SOW_Draft_v1.pdf (application/pdf), MAP_AstraNova_GoLive.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Date: 2027-05-19T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sales → CS: AstraNova kickoff readiness & acceptance checklist

Thanks for the summary Rafael.

Quick answers and next steps from CS:
- Tentative owners: Karthik Iyer (Eng PM, onboarding lead) and Monica Patel (Customer Success Manager). I'll confirm capacity by EOD.
- Timeline: assuming SOW/PO signed by 5/28 we can hit 6/14 but will need to run a prep sprint the week of 6/1.
- Security: we'll need SOC2 report, network diagram, and confirmation on KMS integration scope. Please ask AstraNova to upload artifacts to the shared Drive folder.

Open questions for AstraNova (Jordan/Samantha):
1) Who will be the technical point of contact for infra/network (name + email)?
2) Do you require an air-gapped install or is VPC-only in our us-east-1 acceptable?
3) Any blackout windows for June for your engineers?

I'll review the SOW and mark any items that affect SLA or delivery milestones.

-Karthik
